'''Angus Thermopyle''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==Biography==
By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Angus Thermopyle was researching on the sudden [[Death/Legends|death]]s of [[Joran Wostikian]] and his [[Joran Wostikian's wife|wife]]. While doing research, Thermopyle was killed by the killers.<ref name="Prelude to ANH" />
